display_long_description:
Ready to go full monke?

Gorilla Game is a chaotic VR multiplayer playground built around fast, hand-based movement. Climb, swing, launch, dodge, and juke your way through loud lobbies full of monke madness.

The main place to play is Sandbox Mode. Hang out with friends, use guns, practice movement, mess around, meet new players, and create your own fun. It is the social hub where most monkes gather.

Jump into different modes whenever you want more action:

Forest Infection
Run through the trees, climb fast, and escape infected monkes chasing you down.

Clouds Infection
Take infection into the sky with risky jumps, floating platforms, and fast escapes.

Fireball Monke
Dodge, aim, and blast other players with fireballs in fast PvP battles.

ZoneBall
Work with your team, control the ball, block shots, and score in a high-speed arena mode.

Custom Maps
Build your own maps, explore player creations, and find new ways to play.

Compete, build, practice, or just hang out. Gorilla Game is simple VR movement, social chaos, and nonstop monke fun.
